title: admission-policies chart values schema
description: Plan 2026-05-20 T2.5 ext — fail-fast on missing/invalid admission policy config. Critical because B16-class bug (policy-controller deny-by-default with no matching ClusterImagePolicy) rejects ALL tenant pods cluster-wide.

domain.description: Base domain (e.g., dev.loopzero.example). Used to derive Harbor registry hostname.

docrPrefix.description: DOCR registry prefix MUST end with '/' AND contain no whitespace (anchored pattern catches 'registry with space/' which was accepted by un-anchored '/$' — 2026-05-20 shadow bug). Used as string prefix match in VAP. Empty/missing/garbage = B16 class bug.

harborPrefix.description: Harbor registry prefix. Same B16 risk + anchored pattern catches whitespace garbage.

items.description: Each additional prefix MUST end with '/' AND no whitespace. Standalone-multi sets k3d-loopzero-registry:5000/<tenant>/ for locally-built images.

additionalPrefixes.description: Opt-in additional registry prefixes accepted by restrict-registries VAP. Default empty (prod allows only DOCR + Harbor).

name.description: Policy name (e.g., loopzero-images-warn). Must be unique per ClusterImagePolicy CR.

mode.description: warn=log+admit, enforce=reject unsigned. ADR-0050 default = enforce (local + dev). Prod retains warn until cosign keyless cutover (Sprint 9).

staticAction.description: Static action when no signature verifiable yet. Default 'pass' to avoid breaking during dual-signing window.

imageGlobs.description: At least one image glob required (otherwise policy applies to nothing = useless).

fulcioURL.description: Fulcio cert authority URL (default https://fulcio.sigstore.dev for Sigstore public-good instance). Schema uses pattern (always enforced) instead of format:uri (silently permissive in default jsonschema).

rekorURL.description: Rekor transparency log URL (default https://rekor.sigstore.dev). Pattern-based per format:uri silent-permissiveness bug class (2026-05-20).

oidcIssuer.description: OIDC issuer URL — MUST be BUILD cluster's external OIDC URL (NOT intra-cluster). Per T1.4 of plan 2026-05-27-tenant-build-pipeline-gaps-closure v1.1 EC-NEW-4. Empty default + chart fail-fast (Helm fail() in cluster-image-policy.yaml) prevent accidental render. Pattern allows empty OR https URL.

identityRegexp.description: Identity regex MUST narrowly scope to expected OIDC subjects (e.g., '^https://github\.com/getloopscale/loopzero/'). Wildcard = supply chain risk.

vaps.description: Per-VAP toggles. Each MUST be explicit boolean (no defaulting via Helm null coalescing).
